subject: Card declined at checkout
body: My card was declined when I tried to pay for my order just now. Tried twice, same result.

subject: Money deducted, no order confirmation
body: The amount was deducted from my bank account but I never got an order confirmation. Where is my order?

subject: UPI not going through
body: UPI payment keeps failing at the last step. It just spins and then says try again later.

subject: Checkout page shows an error
body: I get a red error banner on the checkout page right after I click pay. Nothing else happens.

subject: Paid twice, charged once shown on statement
body: I tried paying twice because the first attempt seemed to fail, and now my bank statement shows one charge but the app still says pending.

subject: Payment stuck on processing
body: The payment screen has been stuck on 'processing' for over ten minutes now. I don't know if it went through.

subject: Can't complete purchase
body: I keep trying to buy this item and it just won't let me finish. Something breaks right at the end.

subject: Netbanking redirect failed
body: I was sent to my bank's site to approve the payment, approved it, and then got sent back to an error page here.

subject: Wallet balance not accepted
body: My wallet has enough balance but the app refuses to use it for this order and just fails.

subject: Transaction declined by bank, but amount held
body: My bank says the transaction was declined, yet the amount is showing as held / on hold on my account.

subject: App crashes during payment
body: The app just closes itself the moment I tap the pay button. This has happened four times today.

subject: Order shows unpaid despite bank confirmation
body: My bank sent me an SMS confirming the debit, but the order here still says unpaid.

subject: Credit card payment rejected
body: Rejected immediately with no reason given, same card worked fine last week.

subject: NEFT transfer for order not recognised
body: I sent the money via NEFT as instructed but the order was never marked as paid.

subject: Payment gateway timeout
body: Got a timeout message after waiting a while on the payment page, and I'm not sure if I was charged.

subject: IMPS payment bounced back
body: Tried IMPS for the order total and it bounced back to my account with no explanation.

subject: Debit card OTP never arrived
body: The OTP for my debit card payment never came through, so the payment just failed.

subject: Double charge on my statement
body: I see two identical charges on my card statement for what should have been one order.

subject: Refund not received for failed payment
body: The payment failed on my end three days ago but I still haven't gotten my money back.

subject: Checkout button does nothing
body: I click the pay button on checkout and literally nothing happens, no loading, no error.

subject: Amount debited, cart still shows items
body: The money left my account but my cart is still sitting there like nothing happened.

subject: Card verification keeps failing
body: It asks me to verify my card every time and then says verification failed with no useful detail.

subject: UPI app shows success, order shows pending
body: My UPI app confirmed the payment went through, but the order status here is still pending.

subject: Payment page keeps reloading
body: The whole payment page refreshes itself every few seconds, I can't even enter my details.

subject: Wrong amount charged
body: I was charged more than the order total, not sure where the extra amount came from.

subject: Bank declined citing merchant issue
body: Called my bank, they said the merchant side declined it, but I have no idea why.

subject: Saved card no longer works at checkout
body: The card I've used many times before now fails every time I try to check out.

subject: Payment confirmation email never sent
body: I paid successfully according to my bank but never received any confirmation email from you.

subject: Split payment failed halfway
body: I tried to pay partly by card and partly by wallet, and it failed after debiting only the card part.

subject: Checkout says session expired mid-payment
body: Right as I was entering my card details, it told me my session expired and I lost everything.

subject: Payment succeeded but order cancelled itself
body: The payment clearly went through but a few minutes later the order was automatically cancelled.

subject: International card rejected without reason
body: My card is from another country and it just gets rejected with no explanation given.

subject: EMI option failing at final step
body: Chose to pay by EMI, filled everything in, and it fails right at the last confirmation step.

subject: Payment link expired before I could use it
body: The payment link you sent expired almost immediately, I barely had time to click it.

subject: Cannot remove failed payment method
body: There's a payment attempt stuck showing as failed and I can't get past it to try another method.

subject: Currency mismatch during payment
body: The amount shown at checkout does not match what my bank is trying to charge me.

subject: Payment retried automatically and charged twice
body: It looks like the system retried my payment on its own and now I've been charged for the same order twice.

subject: Gateway redirected to a blank page
body: After entering my payment details I was redirected to a completely blank page and nothing since.
